features.name: AL language extension pre-release versions
features.description: The AL language extension now offers pre-release version installation and switching, providing early access to bug fixes, previews, and future functionality alongside stable release versions.

features.name: AL language extension for Linux
features.description: The AL language extension can now be installed and used on Linux systems, including Windows Subsystem for Linux, enabling AL developers to work from their favorite Linux environment.
features.status_evidence_quote: One thing we introduced with the preview functionality is the ability to install the AL language extension on Linux.
caveats: Still in preview

features.name: DevOps syntax highlighting
features.description: A new extension allows color coding of AL code when displayed in Azure DevOps, providing syntax highlighting for AL language in DevOps environments.
features.status_evidence_quote: Another thing we added as a preview is syntax highlighting for DevOps.

features.name: Namespaces in AL language
features.description: A major new feature introducing namespaces to organize AL objects and identifiers into logical groups, reducing name clashes and improving code organization. Namespaces are declared as the first statement in a source file and can be nested.
caveats: Still has restrictions on object naming without fixes
Requires dependencies to be namespaced before namespacing own code

features.name: Using directives for namespace imports
features.description: Using directives allow importing all objects from a specified namespace into the current source file scope, enabling easier access to namespaced objects without fully qualifying them.

features.name: Fully qualified object names
features.description: Objects can be fully qualified with their complete namespace path to ensure unambiguous reference, useful when multiple objects with the same name exist in different namespaces.

features.name: Namespace code actions
features.description: IDE code actions automatically suggest adding using statements or fully qualifying object names when namespace-related errors are detected, helping developers quickly resolve namespace issues.

features.name: AL Explorer group by namespace
features.description: AL Explorer now supports grouping objects by namespace, allowing developers to discover and navigate related objects within different namespaces and dependent apps.

features.name: AL Doc reference documentation tool
features.description: New documentation tool that produces reference documentation from AL source code. Generates structured, consistent documentation with predictable layout, fields, keys, methods, and links for all documented objects.
caveats: starting slowly with first-party apps coverage
partner adoption requires their own effort

features.name: XML documentation comments in AL
features.description: AL language supports XML documentation comments that can be used to generate reference documentation. Comments are currently surfaced in IntelliSense and code editor hover tooltips and signature help.

features.name: AL Doc init command
features.description: One-time initialization command that sets up a folder with templates needed for AL reference documentation generation. Called once per documentation repository.

features.name: AL Doc build command
features.description: Command that regenerates documentation from .app files whenever code changes. Produces YAML files for individual objects, modules, and supporting information containing both structure and XML documentation comments.

features.name: DocFX integration for HTML generation
features.description: AL Doc produces YAML files which are then processed by the open-source DocFX tool. DocFX combines templates, YAML, and markdown into static HTML websites for documentation.

features.name: GitHub Pages integration for documentation hosting
features.description: Documentation generated by AL Doc and DocFX can be hosted on GitHub Pages using a docs folder in the repository, enabling automatic documentation hosting alongside source code.

features.name: Explore page in Visual Studio Code
features.description: New page inspector option that automatically provisions a Visual Studio Code workspace, creates app.json with required extension dependencies, generates launch configurations, authenticates, and downloads symbols to investigate a page's source code.
caveats: requires troubleshooting tools permission
first authentication requires special signing process
requires AL Visual Studio Code extension

features.name: AL Explorer
features.description: Tool to discover and navigate AL objects, supporting grouping by namespace and drilling into namespaces to see what objects are available, with ability to jump to source code or run objects in the client.

features.name: Explore field in Visual Studio Code
features.description: New field dropdown option that provisions VS Code, downloads symbols, and brings developer directly to the source code for a table field to inspect validation and other logic.
caveats: requires troubleshooting tools permission
requires source code access

features.name: Attach debugger from help and support
features.description: New option in help and support troubleshooting section to attach debugger to current session, provisioning VS Code with base and system application extensions as dependencies.
caveats: no page context so fewer dependencies available
accessible to all users

features.name: Troubleshooting tools permission
features.description: Permission required to use explore options in page inspector. Controls access to light investigation and troubleshooting capabilities.

features.name: Shared symbols path
features.description: Ability to reuse downloaded symbols across VS Code instances to avoid redundant downloading and save time.

features.name: Future: CodeSpaces Integration
features.description: Planned feature to open source code in cloud CodeSpaces instead of locally in VS Code, reducing content switching overhead.
caveats: No commits; future idea

features.name: Future: GitHub Source Integration
features.description: Planned feature to integrate with GitHub to pull source code from there, either for the specific version deployed on the server or the latest version for development.
caveats: Future idea

features.name: Future: Bulk Symbol Download
features.description: Planned feature to download symbols for all extensions at once or for a specific set of extensions, possibly from the extension management page.
caveats: Future idea

features.name: Error Details with Call Stack
features.description: Error details now display the call stack, visible in purple, providing context about where problems occur in the code.

features.name: Debug Console IntelliSense
features.description: The debug console now supports IntelliSense when evaluating expressions, providing autocomplete for fields, locals, globals, and member symbols to improve discoverability and productivity.
caveats: Does not support evaluation of methods

features.name: AL Profiler Sampling Interval Options
features.description: The AL profiler now provides configurable sampling intervals: 50 ms, 100 ms (default), or 150 ms. Lower intervals provide more granularity; higher intervals limit data and focus on large operations.

features.name: Implicit Variant to Dictionary and List Conversion
features.description: AL now supports implicit conversion of variants to dictionaries and lists. Two new methods added to the variant type: is dictionary and is list.

features.name: Secure Text Data Type
features.description: New AL data type for variables and parameters that protects data from being debugged, including normal and snapshot debugging. Secures data when constructed in non-debuggable methods.
caveats: Does not protect data shared outside Business Central
Must be constructed in non-debuggable methods

features.name: Secure Request URI and Headers
features.description: Support for setting secret request URIs and headers using secure text type, preventing access to sensitive data including API keys embedded in URLs during debugging.

features.name: New Field Groups on Base Objects
features.description: AL extensions can now add fields to field groups that do not exist in the base object, enabling new scenarios like adding brick field groups to GL entries for display customization.
caveats: Add last continues to exclude duplicates across extensions

features.name: Allow in customization property
features.description: Table fields now have an allow in customization property to control whether fields can be used in profile customization, providing finer control than requiring fields to be added to pages.

features.name: Analysis mode control on list pages
features.description: List pages now support setting analysis mode enabled to false to disable detailed analysis capabilities where they are not suitable.

features.name: Barcode extended data type
features.description: New extended data type for fields that automatically displays a scanner button on devices, making data entry via device camera much easier.

features.name: Rich text extended data type
features.description: New extended data type enabling rich content capabilities on fields with formatting, images, and links. Requires multi-line true and placement in its own group.
caveats: Requires multi-line set to true
Must be alone in its own group
Cannot be used in repeaters or groups with other fields
Cannot customize toolbar
Limited personalization
Requires backing by types without size like text
Value is HTML with inline images

features.name: Queries in run objects for actions
features.description: Queries can now be used in run object for actions, and usage category can be set to display queries in Tell Me search results.

features.name: Query about title and about text
features.description: About title and about text properties enable building rich teaching tips for queries to help users understand the queries built.

features.name: Excel layout multiple data sheets
features.description: Split each data item into its own data sheet in Excel reports, reducing complexity and improving size, rendering performance, and authoring ease.

features.name: AL inlay hints for parameters and return types
features.description: Inlay hints show parameter names and return types inline in source code. Can be toggled with keyboard shortcut or set to always on or off.
caveats: Must be enabled in Visual Studio Code settings and AL inlay hints collection

features.name: Label hover value display
features.description: Hover over a label variable to see its value without navigating or using peak definition.

features.name: Improved IntelliSense for overloaded methods
features.description: IntelliSense now smartly picks the recommended method signature by matching provided parameters and reordering suggestions accordingly.

features.name: IntelliSense for key parameters
features.description: IntelliSense now lists available keys when working with methods that accept keys, such as set current keys.

features.name: Find all references for triggers and methods
features.description: Improved find all references functionality now works on trigger and system methods, trigger events, page and table fields, page actions, and table methods and events.

features.name: AL Go default project folder setting
features.description: User can now override and set the default folder for AL Go projects or the default root location.

features.name: AL compilation output folder
features.description: In AL compilation options, specify an out folder for apps, allowing output to be located outside the project folder.
caveats: Project will still contain a node for the output file but it could physically be located outside the project

features.name: GitHub Copilot Chat for AL
features.description: Interactive chat experience inside Visual Studio Code for coding assistance. Can explain code, propose fixes, answer code questions, and generate unit tests.
caveats: Training material based on open-source code which is fairly limited for AL
Results vary in quality
Is an assistant tool not a replacement for human programming
Review generated content especially for AL

features.name: AppSource per user pricing with direct sales
features.description: First wave of AppSource transactability with per user pricing model supporting direct sales channel via credit card.
features.status_evidence_quote: That is as I'm talking now in public preview, but on October 9th, that will actually go into GA.

features.name: AppSource CSP support
features.description: Cloud Solution Provider support for AppSource transactability is being developed and is currently in private preview with select partners.
features.status_evidence_quote: in the in the middle of a private preview with select partners on this, but that is

features.name: AppSource entitlements mapping
features.description: Sample app demonstrates how to create entitlements that map licenses from Partner Center to Business Central app permissions.

features.name: Entitlements documentation for license mapping
features.description: Updated documentation page on entitlements used to map licenses created in Partner Center for offers to permissions granted in Business Central apps.

features.name: Enhanced developer resources and documentation
features.description: Collaboration with partners has led to updating HTTP client, reporting, extensibility, and learn topics with more detail and examples.

features.name: Performance tool kit
features.description: Investment in performance tool kit for testing and ensuring app performance in Business Central.

features.name: BC Icons overview
features.description: Overview of icons available for use in AL development for Business Central.
